item.cursedrelics.forgotten_contract.des: §oNo one even remembers anymore who exactly entered into that contract.
§8Mobs attacked by a player equipped with the “Forgotten Contract” will have their healing effects disabled.
item.cursedrelics.ring_of_alchemists.des: §oThis ring is the original model for the rings that alchemists have been crafting since ancient times.
§8Anyone who equips this ring will have half of the damage they take accumulated in the ring, while the other half is negated.
§8This ring consumes Accumulation to slowly deal damage to the wearer.
§8If you recover while having Accumulation, instead of recovering health, an amount of Accumulation equal to the recovery amount is deducted.
§8The Accumulation cap is always equal to your current Health; any Accumulation exceeding this cap is immediately consumed, and you take damage equal to that amount.
§8However, when the Accumulation cap is reduced, even if the current Accumulation exceeds the new cap, the excess Accumulation is still subtracted.
